snippet.title: #AdvJam2015 #12: Last Case: The Disappearance of Amanda Kane - Full Playthrough (no commentary)
snippet.description:
Full playthrough of Last Case: The Disappearance of Amanda Kane, an original short free-to-play point-and-click narrative made for Adaventure Jame 2015, recorded by Eric, published 17 December 2018.

Last Case: The Disappearance of Amanda Kane is longplay No. 284 of the Ludophiles longplays project:
- https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFXG3BI19O5rpA9sB1_-K_x5s207hoahb
- http://www.ludophiles.com/threads/ludophiles-longplays-project.180/
